Office Visit Note
Patient: Morgan Ashby-Vale
DOB: 02/17/1981
Date of Service: 03/14/2025
Provider: Dr. Ines Castellanos-Reyes

Subjective:
Patient presents for follow up regarding low back pain following an incident at work on 03/11/2025.
Patient reports a lumbar strain in 2019 after moving furniture, resolved with rest.
Current pain level is 4/10, localized to the lower back.
Patient denies fever, chills, or neurological symptoms.
Review of systems is otherwise negative.

Objective:
Vitals: Temp 98.6 F, BP 120/78, HR 72, RR 16.
Physical exam reveals mild tenderness in the lumbar paraspinal muscles.
Range of motion is slightly restricted in flexion and extension.
No signs of radiculopathy noted.

Assessment:
Lumbar strain, likely work related.
Restrictions: no lifting over 10 pounds and no repetitive bending through 04/11/2025.
Referred to physical therapy, two visits per week for six weeks.
Plan:
Continue conservative management.
Follow up in four weeks or sooner if symptoms worsen.

Dr. Ines Castellanos-Reyes
